# RAVET synthetic ligature fixture

`RavetSyntheticLigature.ttf` is first-party reusable test data generated by
[generate.py](generate.py). It contains only primitive rectangular outlines for
`.notdef`, `f`, `i` and `ffi`, a blank space, explicit advances, and the GSUB
substitution `f f i → ffi`. No external font glyphs or proprietary product assets
are copied. It is covered by RAVET's first-party licence. It has no GDEF caret
positions: tests verify the framework's documented equal-grapheme interpolation,
rather than claiming font-provided ligature caret measurement.

Units per em are 1000; the ffi advance is 1000, so shaping at size 24 produces one
24-unit glyph and three 8-unit grapheme cells. This independently supplies exact
expected source carets and selection pen geometry. It is deliberately a test font,
not typography for consumer products.

Optional regeneration requires fontTools 4.62.1 (MIT; development-only, outside
Cargo/runtime dependencies), with constant font timestamps:

```sh
python3 crates/ravet-surface/tests/fixtures/caret/generate.py
```

SHA-256 of the checked-in generated font:
`f8dbab0d21ca0e43ac019347baa30b416140dd1c468a254051b7ef6ac9aa7267`.
